**A.** The deposition is admissible as former testimony under FRE 804(b)(1). The engineer is unavailable, the company's own attorney deposed him under oath on the same safety-report and structural-defect issues, so the company had both the opportunity and a similar motive to examine him. Choice B fails because he was a former employee when he testified, and D fails because the company did cross-examine him.

CONFIDENCE: 70
